requirements.description:
Read the following Bible texts and explain what they teach about the role God expects every Christian to play in meeting the needs of the poor and suffering in the community.
  a) Luke 10:25-37
  b) Matthew 25:31-46
Read chapter 54 (titled “The Good Samaritan”) of The Desire of Ages by Ellen G. White and write a list of 5 key points from the chapter.

3. Explain the following to your instructor:
  a) What is the name of the Adventist organization in your country that serves those in need? What services does it offer?
  b) What is the name of the Adventist organization that serves those in need outside the United States, Canada and Bermuda? What kinds of services does it provide? Explain the difference between “development” and “relief”.
  - What items are usually included in a personal hygiene kit?
Assemble a personal hygiene kit and donate it to Adventist Community Services, ADRA Canada, or a homeless shelter.

Meet with the Adventist Community Services leader (in the United States and Bermuda) or the ADRA Canada leader in your area and ask about projects your unit or class could carry out to help meet the needs of your community.
Plan a community service project with your unit or class and complete it.
Complete at least 4 hours of volunteer service, including the time invested in the project mentioned in requirement 8 and time donated to other community service activities.
